revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Ln 6: Yes, there doesn't appear to be an epsilon. The substitution of ὡς for ἕως is not unheard of in later Greek, see LSJ, ὡς Ad. 2 and Gignac I, 305 (w/ fn. 3). Perhaps better to keep ὡς in the text and note the regularized reading ἕως.
